module_scope_note: These module names are not globally banned forever. They are banned for this first pack because the rows are meta/project/training-oriented rather than friend-facing answer-as-user samples.
row_52_policy_interpretation: Row 52 is user feedback rejecting this later-question category for corpus expansion. Treat it as policy instruction, not as a training sample.
future_pack_default: Rows with project-meta, training-meta, status, tool-state, phase-review, or corpus-strategy intent must be excluded_from_training by default unless separately reviewed and reframed as real external-facing answer-as-user material.
